answer: Locks are entered in meadow, expire in tide, and ocean lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 157 aliases hence needs 77 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2117 identities would post 3215 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
